title: Getting started
summary: Join, update, choose your classes and begin your first adventure.
body:
Nightcap is a solo-preferred EverQuest server with three classes per character and a Classic level cap of 50. Start here, then explore the major differences from standard EQ.

Join the server

Ask the server owner for an account, personal access code and setup instructions. Keep your access code private; enter it only in the official launcher. The public wiki does not create game accounts or grant server access. The player site is available to approved players.

Update before playing

Fully close the game and launcher. Reopen your usual Nightcap shortcut and let it update before pressing Play. Keep your existing game folder. See Launcher & interface.

First steps in the tunnel

  1. New characters arrive in the East Commonlands tunnel with 100 platinum and a starting kit.
  2. Hail the Ancient Chronicler to choose two different extra classes. Your original class remains your Primary. Read Multiclass & progression.
  3. Find your class trainer and spell merchant in the class gatherings. Buy and learn eligible spells.
  4. Hail Matron Restora for free, level-appropriate blessings.
  5. Speak to Merrin in the travel area when you are ready to leave. Read Travel & instances for return options.

Choose your next goal

Try advanced loot, plan a pet roster, discover waypoints, hunt zone rewards, or choose a Raid or Grind dungeon run. Installed features are available for live testing; some combinations and client behaviors still need acceptance.

Choose early AA upgrades

Keep AA allocation at 0% (#aaexp off) to earn full leveling EXP and two AA per level. Use the AA +/− controls from level 1; select 100% to pause leveling for AA grinding. Open Alternate Advancement and try the optional Recommended AA filter for a short survival, sustain and damage shortlist.
